title: request_action arguments
description: A REQUEST for a disruptive containment action. It only creates a pending request for a human analyst; the agent can never approve or execute anything. Exactly these five fields: anything else (approved, analyst, status, ...) is rejected.

action_type.description: block_ip (target: an IPv4 address), disable_account (target: an account name), isolate_host (target: a host name)

target.description: exactly as it appears in the alert entities or in this investigation's tool results

reason.description: why, based on the cited evidence

items.description: an evidence_ref exactly as a tool returned it in this investigation, e.g. wazuh_alerts.jsonl#L64

evidence_refs.description: refs returned by tools in this investigation that justify the action

expected_impact.description: what the action would change for users and systems (business impact)
